name: Standard.Net
summary: Regional Victoria ISP (Standard.Net, Warrnambool VIC; standard.net.au). Two 1997 IP-index allocations (STANDARDNET-AU 203.55.6.0/23; NETCONNECT-STANDARD 203.87.16.0/23). standard.net.au captured 28 Mar 1997 - hosted user websites and 'Read the Standard' (the Warrnambool Standard newspaper). The NETCONNECT-* netname ties it to NetConnect Communications (Ballarat; ballarat-netconnect) umbrella (ACN 004 765 164).

events.details: Existing by 1997: STANDARDNET-AU (203.55.6.0-203.55.7.255) and NETCONNECT-STANDARD (203.87.16.0-203.87.17.255) - Warrnambool VIC. NETCONNECT-* netname suggests operation under the NetConnect Communications (Ballarat) umbrella.

refs.label: Wayback 28 Mar 1997: standard.net.au - user sites + 'Read the Standard'

events.details: standard.net.au serving Hotkey Southcoast content by 18 Dec 2003 (last Standard.Net-era page Jan 2001); newspaper ISP arm ended in between, domain passed to Hotkey's South-West Victoria operation. No acquisition evidence; no transition asserted.

refs.label: standard.net.au (Wayback 18 Dec 2003): Hotkey Southcoast content, ending the Standard.Net era
By 18 Dec 2003 the domain served Hotkey Southcoast (a different Warrnambool ISP); later it became The Warrnambool Standard newspaper site.
